notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.0.5
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29252770/9a5703096aaaa7f9f49b929a17b74ec2232349af.png[/img]

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Slow motion effect can be turned ON/OFF in the gameplay settings menu
    [*]You can now auto pickup ammo, grenades and health packs in Survive game mode by simply moving over the item
    [*]Slow motion now automatically ends when you reload your weapon to reduce idle time
[/list] 

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Level collision fixes
    [*]Reduced rewarded XP and RP in Survive game mode
    [*]Increased the collision boxes of collectible items in Survive game mode
    [*]User interface fixes
    [*]Increased recoil of some weapons for more realistic behavior
    [*]You can no longer interact with the world after you die
[/list]

notes.title: New features and fixes
notes.content:
- Added support for ultra wide monitors with 21:9 aspect ratio.
- FOV is now adjustable in the gameplay settings.
- Added full controller support.
- Minor bug fixes
